lines.t: The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali,
By the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan,
Galilee of the Gentiles...
The people who sat in darkness have seen a great Light,
And upon those who sat in the region and shadow of death,
Light has dawned...
From my youth I walked in darkness
This world knew not Your ways
No one taught me of Your commandments
Or how to walk in truth each day
I looked for truth in all directions
But found confusion everywhere
Even those who spoke about You
Did not bear the fruit of Your Spirit
My feet did not stand upon Your laws
So darkness covered me
Temptation ruled my unguarded heart
And drained the life from me
Till broken, trembling, barely breathing
I cried out for Your light
And You answered me
Your presence filled the deep
Light rushed into my darkness
And awakened me from sleep
Light has dawned upon the shadows
Yet the people love their chains
Holding tightly to deception
While their souls dissolve in pain
Oh I long to shout Your name aloud
Across the earth and through the night
That every weary heart might hear You
And awaken to the light
Teach us the paths of life
Lead the weary safely home
For we are lost without Your Spirit
We are dust without Your breath
Let Your mercy flood the nations
And awaken hearts from death
You rescued me from darkness
And revealed Your truth to me
The Volumes of Truth laid open
And my soul began to breathe
And my whole spirit cried out “TRUTH!”
As scales fell from my blinded eyes
You taught me Your Sabbaths, Your law
And how to abide
You called me out from dead traditions
And the lies upheld by men
The teachings that had chained my spirit
And kept me from knowing the Great I AM
You called me to be set apart
From every false and crooked way
No longer led by hollow teachings
But by Your Spirit day to day
Light has dawned upon the shadows
Yet the people still refuse
The living waters flowing freely
While choosing darkness over You
Oh I long to shout Your name aloud
Across the earth and through the night
That every weary heart might hear You
And awaken to the light
Teach us the paths of life
Lead the weary safely home
For we are lost without Your Spirit
We are dust without Your breath
Let Your mercy flood the nations
And awaken hearts from death
Everywhere the darkness deepens
And the hearts of men decay
New heights of evil rising daily
As the truth is cast away
And my soul cries out in anguish
For the people still asleep
Lost within the noise and chaos
Far from waters running deep
Oh if only they could taste
Even one glimpse of Heaven’s peace
To be freed from all the chaos
And the striving of this place
To walk beside the Holy One
And no longer fear the night
For only You can heal the broken
And lead us to the light
Only You can give us life
When this world has lost its way
Only You can lead us safely
Through this ever-darkening age
Light has dawned upon the shadows
Yet the people love the night
Trading truth away for emptiness
And calling darkness light
Oh Lord let them hear You
Before their hearts grow cold as stone
Call the weary from the shadows
And lead the wandering safely home
Teach us the paths of life
Write Your truth upon our hearts
For only You can heal the nations
Torn and broken in the dark
And though the darkness deepens round us
Your Light still pierces through the night
And every soul who seeks Your presence
Will awaken to the Light
The people who sat in darkness...
Have seen a great Light...
And upon those who sat
In the region and shadow of death...
Light has dawned...
Lord, teach us the paths of life...
